name: Akhtar Faizi Putra
tagline: Building clean, functional products for web and mobile — from React dashboards to Kotlin apps.
about: Hi! I'm a versatile full-stack developer with hands-on experience across web and mobile application development. I enjoy turning ideas into real, working products — solving practical problems through clean code, thoughtful design, and a bit of machine learning along the way.

Over the past couple of years I've built dashboard systems, an attendance platform with face recognition and geolocation, and contributed to a proprietary payment gateway for the Middle Eastern market. I also spend time mentoring — guiding learners through React.js and Android development as a facilitator and division mentor.
Outside of building things, I like digging into technical documentation, exploring new frameworks, and helping teammates get unstuck on tricky bugs.
